title: Qwen APP Education Discount Launches, Work Assistant Features Membership for 9.9 Yuan/Month

content_html:
On September 9, the Qwen APP launched a membership promotion for college students and teachers. After completing identity verification, users can subscribe to the premium and elite memberships at discounted prices for six consecutive months, gaining more usage quotas for features such as work assistants and PPT generation. The discounted price for the premium membership is 9.9 yuan per month, originally 19 yuan per month; the discounted price for the elite membership is 25 yuan per month, originally 49 yuan per month.

This promotion mainly targets high-frequency and complex task scenarios such as work assistants. Work assistants can autonomously break down tasks and call tools based on user needs, completing multi-step tasks such as research analysis, material organization, web page creation, and Office document generation. Students can use it to manage course materials, complete class presentations, and set up research application workstations, while teachers can use it for organizing teaching materials and creating courseware for teaching and office tasks.

Currently, features such as work assistants are available for free. For complex tasks or higher-frequency usage needs, users can get more usage quotas by upgrading to a membership. Users can send "I want to claim the education discount" in the Qwen APP or PC version, and after completing identity verification according to the page instructions, they can enjoy the corresponding discounts.
